svg.title: Plastic Hunter AI – System Architecture
svg.desc: Horizontal workflow diagram showing five stages: user uploads an image, AI detection engine processes it, plastic is detected with bounding boxes, results stored with GPS data, and displayed on an interactive dashboard and global map.
svg.text: End-to-end AI pipeline for ocean plastic detection and monitoring
Python · YOLOv8 · FastAPI · PostgreSQL + PostGIS · React · Leaflet.js
